kind: real-dependency per-image compile (P5 slice C), fresh fix-167 build
notes: The old gate reported binding=12 for this image; that is a Roslyn artifact: a file with parse errors aborts the binding phase entirely. With fix-167's 0 parse errors the binding phase actually runs for the first time.
CS1750 (int->enum default arg) is CS1xxx-band but is a binding error, not a parser error; real parser errors = 0.

C8 generic spelling: the backtick-arity mangling (`List`1`->`List_1<T>`) is a self-hosting choice; against real BCL/engine DLLs every framework generic fails to bind. Prototype (strip `_N` before `<`) cuts AC binding 58410->28697 (-29713), CS0101 collisions = 0.
Enum literals: `_KEYWORD = 287` for an enum field/const/param-default must be `(E)287`.

Cross-game-assembly refs (e.g. ATTRIBUTE_TYPE from InterfacesLibraryAssembly) resolve only when compiling the referenced image too; external third-party (CodeStage/FMOD/UniTask/TMP/Spine/DOTween) is absent from the gameonly role set.
